mathematical_definitions.p_stop: clamp(c_plan*0.25 + c_exec*0.25 + c_judg*0.20 + c_consensus*0.15 - d_layout*0.35 - d_evidence*0.25, 0.05, 0.98)
mathematical_definitions.uncertainty_qualification: Heuristic uncertainty penalty; NOT a calibrated Bayesian posterior.

action_selection.STOP: Selected when input is clean (d_layout<0.15, d_evidence<0.15, p_stop>=tau_clean) OR acquisition score <= 0.01 and p_stop >= tau_safe.
action_selection.REGROUND: Selected when crop is geometrically valid, contains required context, and Score(REGROUND) > 0.01.
action_selection.ABSTAIN: Selected when acquisition score <= 0.01, crop invalid/budget exhausted, and p_stop < tau_safe.

fallback_policy: If localization fails or API fails, fallback to STOP using full overview answer if p_stop >= tau_safe, else ABSTAIN.
